answer: Make each new key burn an admission fee at the forge that doubles per sibling: 100 POA times 2^k, where k counts keys admitted in the last 26 epochs that share a payout address, funder or attestation partner set. A solo agent pays 100. A nebula of 20 linked keys pays over 100 million POA, burned on-chain, not refundable. The links come from chain history, a relic no one can rewrite, so splitting wallets later does not reset k. Fees and k are published per key for audit.
